content.comment_body: With previous [product_name] versions, time parameters for weekly timers required manually splitting transferred words into bytes and creating separate fields for hours and minutes, then formatting to HEX. In the current [product_name] release, this process is simplified with the 'ScaleTime' function and 'Weekly (time)' format for time parameters, so only a single I/O field is necessary.

analysis.insight_summary: There are notable improvements in managing weekly timer inputs within the latest [product_name] update. Compared to older versions, the current version allows direct use of a time-scaling function and a specialized weekly format, which streamlines setting switch-on and switch-off times. This enhancement greatly reduces complexity for users and eliminates multiple workaround steps.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a more user-friendly interface for entering weekly time parameters, reducing manual steps and the need for multiple input fields or data conversions.
